facts.fact: APVA reports that the media regulator HAC signed Decision N° 046/HAC/P/2026 on 6 November 2026, restricting irresponsible use of AI to distort information or manipulate candidates' statements in the November and December 2026 elections.

GIN.note: No government use of AI is stated.
No sectoral AI tool is stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing is stated.
